title: Why not both? Complementing explanations with uncertainty, and the role of self-confidence in Human-AI collaboration
reasoning: The paper focuses on human-AI collaboration, specifically how uncertainty estimates and explanations affect user reliance, trust, and understanding in a predictive task (salary prediction using a gradient boosting decision tree). While it mentions ethical and fairness concerns in the introduction as motivation for human-in-the-loop systems, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, ethics, or morals.
